geometryDisclosure: OpenStreetMap feature centers, NOT parking entrances, public-access clearance, launch-pad locations, lines of sight or driving directions

places.name: Ocean Beach Park
places.scene: Close coastal atmosphere after liftoff, no direct pad view. Small parking area; road can close once full.
places.accessNote: Park open dawn to dusk. Parking fills, access road can be closed during launches; this is not a live opening report.

places.name: Surf Beach / Surf Station
places.scene: Close to the launch complex when public beach access is available. Stay outside base boundaries and posted nesting closures.
places.accessNote: Vandenberg lists Surf Beach 8 a.m.–6 p.m. daily, but flight operations and protected nesting areas may restrict access. Cross railroad tracks only at permitted crossings.

places.name: Allan Hancock College — Lompoc
places.scene: Partial view of the pad, where terrain allows, with room for a camera or binoculars.
places.accessNote: Campus parking requires a permit during published enforcement periods; the college lists $2 daily parking permits. Campus availability for a particular launch has not been confirmed.

places.name: Riverbend Park
places.scene: Open sports fields and flexible family gathering space. The pad itself is not visible.
places.accessNote: Weekend sports can fill parking. Park hours and event access are not verified for this launch.

places.name: Beattie Park
places.scene: A broad park and elevated outlook over the valley; a convenient family-oriented option, not a confirmed pad sightline.
places.accessNote: Some park areas are wooded or below the ridgeline. Public hours for this launch are not verified; follow posted rules.

places.name: Ryon Memorial Park
places.scene: An easy downtown lawn and picnic option; rocket becomes visible after rising above terrain.
places.accessNote: Park hours and launch-event access have not been verified; favor open lawns away from trees.
